about_the_game:
GAL BOCCHI is an internet artist simulation ADV where you are to bring the artist crawling the sewage of the internet to the top of all fame.

Take control of the recently dumped, heartbroken & depressed bottom-feeding female artist “aimisu_u” and bring her to fame as a goat artist by achieving 100,000 followers!

aimisu_u is a decently skilled artist, but time is cruel; sooner or later she will have to face her reality…

Maximise her last year of escapism and turn her into a legendary artist, let her point a middle finger at her b*tch-ass ex!

・aimisu_u (The female artist you will control)

The poor little girl who complained a bit too much about her failure as an internet artist that caused her to recently get dumped by her last hope, a.k.a. her partner. Or…I mean…ex-partner.

Let’s just hope her career with her new handle (aimisu_u) will grant her final wish!

・Gal-chan

The female character that aimisu_u created to make all the nerds online fall in love!

Draw a bunch of illustrations of Gal-chan and bring aimisu_u the all fame she craves oh-so-badly!

・aimisu_u’s ex

The horrible son of a person that dumped aimisu_u.

Not sure why you share the same name with her ex…

To start your career as an artist, first you’ll have to cut out all the drifting off’s and zoning out’s!

Keep your mind sharp, and open up PAINT — the drawing software you’ll be spending hours with from now on.

The process of drawing is simple; 1. Draw out the lines, 2. colour the picture, and 3. give it a final touch.

You can export the drowing at every process too btw.

aimisu_u is on a track with no path behind, so draw pictures by going for the popular gap-moe image your gal oc will provide. It’ll easily grab every otaku’s heart for sure!

Add some speech bubbles and texts to the picture when you’re done. That extra bit of information will help catch the eye of dudes on social media, giving you a better chance to go viral regardless of your lack of popularity!

Imagine you’re on an actual date with Gal-chan and aim for the realistic atmosphere!

Done with the art? Now’s the time for likes and reposts!

Post your art to XX and let's see how the internet likes it!

⚠Caution

Drawing takes a lot of time! Like a lot of time.

The necessary effort will vary, but one piece will probably take you about a week…A year will pass like a blink of the eye, so thinking ahead and strategising will be more than necessary for you!

Check the comments and responses you got and plan your next piece, repost your prior work, and sometimes go through other apps when you feel too overwhelmed. Depending on your branding strategies, aimisu_u’s artist career will go through a variety of paths!

aimisu_u isn’t young enough for dreaming anymore…This one year is her last shot. I know you won’t mess it up…right?

Creative stuff is all about going losing your mind, so any result besides success will end up with major fuckuppery.

Might be enjoyable watching her crash out, but in the end don’t completely let her down…ok?

Promise?

※Images are subject to modification.

【STAFF】

Planning / Protagonist: aimisu_u

Production Manager: You (the player)

Dev Assistant: Remux2 (ZEROGOHSHA)

Logo Design: SHUHEI Koiso (KOMEWORKS)

Game Dev：Shiawase Forever? & ROUND ZERO, Inc.

short_description: GAL BOCCHI is an internet artist simulator ADV where you control the dogshit female artist “aimisu_u” and become the legendary artist she so desperately wants to become! All the time left for the not-so-young-anymore aimisu_u to escape reality for her dream is…drum roll…1 single year!
